HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
